facts.label: official
facts.quote: The SIP instalment amount could be as small as ₹500 per month and ₹ 250 per month under Chhoti SIP.
facts.text: Under mutual fund systematic investment plans, the minimum monthly installment can be as low as 500 INR.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: If you had invested ₹500 per month for 10, 20, or 30 years, your total investment would have been ₹60,000, ₹1,20,000, and ₹1,80,000, respectively.
facts.text: A salaried individual contributing 500 INR every month over a 20-year period accumulates a total principal deposit of 1,20,000 INR.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: At an assumed 11% annual return, these amounts could have potentially grown to approximately ₹1.05 lakhs, ₹4.30 lakhs, and ₹14 lakhs, respectively.
facts.text: Assuming an annualized return of 11 percent, an investment of 500 INR per month over 20 years could potentially grow to approximately 4.30 lakh INR.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Total amount collected through SIP during September 2026 was ₹ 32,490 crore.
facts.text: Total monthly inflows collected through systematic investment plans across the Indian mutual fund industry hit a record 32,490 crore INR in September 2026.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: SIP contributions stood at ₹32,490 crore, with 10.06 crore contributing SIP accounts during the month, reflecting continued investor participation in systematic investing.
facts.text: Active contributing systematic investment plan accounts across Indian mutual funds reached 10.06 crore during September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: In March 2020, the Sensex fell 38 per cent in four weeks.
facts.text: During the March 2020 market downturn, the benchmark Sensex plunged 38 percent in four weeks, illustrating the severe market drops that rupee-cost averaging navigates.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The gap between regular and direct plans is typically around 0.5 to 1 percent annually.
facts.text: The gap between regular and direct mutual fund expense ratios typically ranges up to 1.0 percent each year.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: That 1.2 per cent annual difference, compounded over 20 years on a Rs 10,000 per month SIP, does not cost Rs 24,000 a year. It costs Rs 31 lakh in final corpus.
facts.text: A 1.2 percent difference in expense ratios compounded over 20 years on a monthly SIP of 10,000 INR can erode 31 lakh INR from the final corpus.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: For equity funds, gains on units held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5% on gains above Rs. 1.25 lakh a year; gains on units held 12 months or less are taxed at 20%.
facts.text: Long-term capital gains on equity mutual fund units held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5 percent on gains above the statutory threshold.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: For equity funds, gains on units held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5% on gains above Rs. 1.25 lakh a year; gains on units held 12 months or less are taxed at 20%.
facts.text: Salaried investors receive an annual tax-free exemption of up to 1.25 lakh INR on long-term capital gains from equity mutual fund redemptions.

script.hook: 500 rupaye mahine ki SIP se 20 saal mein kya banega?

scenes.label: 500 ki SIP ka sach

visual.prompt: A middle-class Indian dining table in the evening, steel cups of chai, a phone face up glowing, family silhouettes leaning in curiously, warm yellow light

scenes.vo: 500 rupaye mahine ki SIP se 20 saal mein kya banega? Yeh sawaal har ghar mein hota hai, chai ke saath, salary ke din. Koi kehta hai raaton raat ameer banoge, koi kehta hai paisa doob jayega. Sach kahin beech mein hai. Aaj poori kahani sunte hain, seedhi baat.

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie sitting on a bed at night, smiling at his phone screen glowing in his hands, excited, a plate of samosas beside him

scenes.vo: Kahani BHAI ki hai. Nayi naukri ki salary aayi hai, phone mein bank ka message chamak raha hai. Usne reel dekhi, SIP shuru karo, paisa badhao. Usne socha, chhota sa amount rakhta hoon, 500 rupaye. Itna toh chai aur samose mein chala jata hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta holding FD receipts at the dining table, BEHEN in office wear looking sceptical over her phone, MUMMY in a saree placing chai with a worried face, BHAI listening, evening

scenes.vo: Dining table pe PAPA ne FD ki rasid nikaali. Bole, beta, FD safe hai, share market juaa hai. BEHEN ne phone se nazar uthaayi aur poocha, 500 se kya hoga? Itne mein toh kuch nahi banta. MUMMY chupchaap chai rakh gayi, thodi si pareshaan.

visual.prompt: A wide city view at dusk with countless lit apartment windows, in many windows small figures look at phones, a sense of a whole country doing the same thing

scenes.vo: Aur BHAI akela nahi hai. AMFI ke hisaab se September 2026 mein 10.06 crore SIP accounts mein har mahine paisa ja raha tha. Matlab bahut saare log har mahine yahi faisla le rahe hain. Toh samajhna zaroori hai ki yeh cheez asal mein kaam kaise karti hai.

visual.prompt: An illustrated big glass jar filling with coins dropped by many different hands, a calm professional in a shirt sorting the coins into neat small boxes, soft daylight

scenes.vo: SIP yaani Systematic Investment Plan. Seedhe shabdon mein, har mahine tay din, tay rakam, apne aap mutual fund mein. Mutual fund yaani bahut logon ka paisa milaakar, koi professional use shares ya bonds mein lagata hai. Aap usme chhota sa hissa kharidte ho, jise unit kehte hain.

visual.prompt: SG, early forties with a beard and striped shirt, standing beside a blank chalkboard in a cosy study, gesturing warmly toward the viewer, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Toh aaj BHAI ki kahani ke saath yeh sawaal suljhaate hain. 500 ki SIP se asal mein kya banega? Market gire toh SIP band karna sahi hai ya galat? Aur expense ratio naam ki cheez chupchaap kitna kha jaati hai? Chaliye, shuru karte hain.

scenes.label: 500 se 20 saal mein kya banega

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear tapping a calculator app on her phone at the dining table, focused frown, BHAI peeking over her shoulder, night lamp light

scenes.vo: BEHEN ka sawaal pehle. Usne phone pe calculator khola. 500 rupaye mahine, 20 saal. Matlab BHAI apni jeb se kul 1,20,000 rupaye daalega. Bas itna hi, na zyada, na kam. Yeh woh paisa hai jo usne kamaaya, bachaaya, aur har mahine alag rakha.

visual.prompt: A small snowball rolling down a gentle hillside, growing bigger as it goes, a tiny figure of BHAI watching from the top in amazement, bright morning

scenes.vo: Ab sawaal yeh hai ki yeh 1,20,000 badhkar kitna banega? Yahan aata hai compounding. Compounding yaani byaaj par byaaj, return par return. Aaj ka munafa kal khud kamaane lagta hai. Shuru mein dheere, baad mein tez, jaise baraf ka gola pahaad se ludhakta hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN with wide surprised eyes looking at her phone, PAPA taking off his spectacles and leaning forward at the dining table, chai steaming, evening

scenes.vo: Tata Mutual Fund ne andaaza diya hai. Ek achha saalana return maan kar, 20 saal mein 500 ki SIP lagbhag 4.30 lakh tak ban sakti hai. BEHEN ki aankhen badi ho gayi. PAPA ne chashma utaara aur dhyan se suna.

visual.prompt: A winding road split into a sunny green path and a grey foggy flat path, BHAI standing at the fork with a small backpack, thoughtful, late afternoon

scenes.vo: Par dhyan se suniye, yeh maan kar hai. Woh return koi vaada nahi, sirf andaaza hai. Kisi achhe daur mein market itna de sakta hai. Kisi sust daur mein bahut kam bhi de sakta hai. Mutual fund mein return tay nahi hota, yahi sach hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI sitting on a balcony looking at his phone with a flat bored expression, grey cloudy sky, a wilted plant pot beside him

scenes.vo: Sust daur ka matlab kya? Kai saal aise aate hain jab market upar neeche hota rehta hai, par kahin pahunchta nahi. Tab aapki SIP ki value lagbhag utni hi dikh sakti hai jitna aapne daala. Isi daur mein log sabse zyada himmat haarte hain.

visual.prompt: A small sapling being watered by BHAI in a clay pot on a windowsill, calm smile, soft morning sunlight

scenes.vo: Toh 500 ki SIP se raaton raat ameer nahi banoge, yeh seedhi baat hai. Par 500 se aadat banti hai. Aur yahi aadat baad mein, salary badhne par, badi SIP banti hai. BHAI ke liye asli munafa yahi tha, shuruaat karna aur tikna.

scenes.label: Crash mein SIP band karein?

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt standing in a dim study, turning toward a window where storm clouds are gathering over the city, serious expression, dusk

scenes.vo: Ab aata hai sabse mushkil sawaal. Market gire toh kya karein? BHAI ki SIP chal rahi thi, sab theek tha. Har mahine 500 katte, app mein chhota sa hara number dikhta. Phir aaya March 2020, aur sab badal gaya.

visual.prompt: A family living room at night, a TV glowing red with a falling chart shape, MUMMY and PAPA watching tensely from the sofa, empty quiet street outside the window

scenes.vo: Lockdown ki khabar, TV par laal screen. Value Research ke mutabik March 2020 mein Sensex kuch hi hafton mein 38 percent gir gaya. Sensex yaani desh ki badi companies ke shares ka thermometer. Thermometer neeche gaya, aur sab ki saans upar.

visual.prompt: BHAI alone in a dark room, face lit by a phone screen showing red colours, sweating, thumb hovering over the screen, late night

scenes.vo: BHAI ne app khola. Jahan hara number tha, wahan laal tha. Usne socha, jitna daala, usse kam dikh raha hai. Abhi band kar doon toh aur nuksaan nahi hoga. Paisa bacha lunga, market theek hoga tab wapas aaunga.

visual.prompt: PAPA waving FD receipts with an I-told-you-so look, MUMMY in a saree clutching a chai cup with worry, BHAI looking down at the floor, dim kitchen light

scenes.vo: Yeh soch galat nahi lagti. Aag lagi ho toh ghar se bhaagna samajh mein aata hai. PAPA ne bhi kaha, dekha, maine bola tha, FD safe hai. MUMMY ne poocha, beta, sab doob toh nahi gaya? Ghar mein dar ka mahaul tha.

visual.prompt: SHOPKEEPER at a kirana counter filling an overflowing cloth bag with red tomatoes, SG and BHAI standing in front, SG smiling and pointing at the bag, bright afternoon

scenes.vo: Yahan SG ne BHAI ko kirane ki dukaan ka example diya. Socho, SHOPKEEPER ke paas tamatar sasta ho gaya. Wahi 500 rupaye, par thaila zyada bhar gaya. Kya aap kehte ho ki sasta hai toh nahi kharidunga? Nahi na.

visual.prompt: An illustrated jar receiving many more small coloured tokens from a funnel while a downward slope glows behind it, BHAI watching with dawning understanding, soft light

scenes.vo: SIP mein bhi yahi hota hai. Har unit ka daam hota hai, jise NAV kehte hain, yaani unit ki keemat. Market gira toh NAV gira. Toh wahi 500 rupaye mein BHAI ko zyada units milte. Isi ko rupee cost averaging kehte hain.

visual.prompt: A seesaw in a park balancing gently in the middle, small tokens on both sides, SG explaining beside it to BHAI, golden evening light

scenes.vo: Rupee cost averaging yaani mehnge mein kam units, saste mein zyada units. Lambe samay mein aapki average keemat beech mein aa jaati hai. Aapko yeh andaaza nahi lagana padta ki market kab girega, kab uthega. SIP yeh kaam apne aap karti hai.

visual.prompt: A young man standing outside a closed glass door watching a crowded bright room inside where people celebrate, regretful face, rainy evening

scenes.vo: Ab socho jisne crash mein SIP band ki. Usne saste units kharidne ka mauka chhod diya. Aur jab market wapas uthta hai, woh aksar baahar khada dekh raha hota hai. Girte waqt rukna aur uthte waqt chhoot jaana, yahi sabse mehngi galti hai.

visual.prompt: WIFE arranging two separate steel boxes on a kitchen shelf, one labelled by colour for emergencies, calm confident face, morning light

scenes.vo: Haan, iska matlab yeh nahi ki market hamesha jaldi wapas aata hai. Kabhi jaldi, kabhi der se. Isiliye SIP ka paisa woh hona chahiye jiski aapko jaldi zaroorat na ho. Ghar ka emergency paisa alag rakho, phir crash mein dar kam lagta hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI putting his phone face down on a table and taking a deep breath, eyes closed, relieved, first light of dawn through the window

scenes.vo: BHAI ne SIP band nahi ki. Kaanpte haathon se usne app band kiya, aur auto debit chalne diya. Woh aaj kehta hai, us mahine maine kuch nahi kiya, aur wahi meri sabse achhi investment thi. Kabhi kabhi kuch na karna hi kaam hai.

scenes.label: Expense ratio kya khata hai

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE behind a bank counter smiling and sliding a form toward BHAI who signs it with a pen, a cup of tea on the counter, bright office lights

scenes.vo: Ab aata hai woh kharcha jo dikhta nahi. BHAI ne apni SIP BANK UNCLE ke kehne par shuru ki thi. Counter pe form, muskaan, chai. Uncle bole, achha fund hai, chinta mat karo. BHAI ne sign kar diya, bina kuch pooche.

visual.prompt: A large water tank with a tiny hidden tap at the bottom slowly dripping, SG pointing at the drip with a knowing look, soft daylight

scenes.vo: Har mutual fund chalane ka kharcha leta hai. Fund manager, office, research, sab ka bill. Isko expense ratio kehte hain, yaani aapke paise ka chhota hissa jo fund har saal fees mein kaat leta hai. Yeh alag bill nahi aata, chupchaap NAV se kat jaata hai.

visual.prompt: Two paths to the same shop door, one longer path passing through a middleman at a desk, one short straight path, BHAI standing at the start looking at both, midday

scenes.vo: Har fund ke paas regular plan bhi hota hai aur direct plan bhi. Regular mein beech mein agent ya distributor hota hai, uska commission bhi aapke expense ratio mein judta hai. Direct mein aap seedhe fund se kharidte ho, beech mein koi nahi.

visual.prompt: BHAI frowning at his phone on the sofa, BEHEN beside him shrugging casually with a cup of coffee, evening lamp light

scenes.vo: BHAI ne baad mein app mein dekha, uska plan regular tha. Direct mein wahi fund, wahi manager, wahi shares, bas fees kam. BEHEN ne kaha, chhota sa fark hai, isme kya rakha hai? Yahi soch lambe samay mein sabse mehngi padti hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN frozen mid-sip with a coffee cup near her lips, eyes wide in shock, staring at a phone screen, BHAI beside her equally stunned, night

scenes.vo: Value Research ne hisaab lagaya. Ek badi SIP par, fees ka chhota sa saalana fark, 20 saal mein final rakam lagbhag 31 lakh kam kar sakta hai. Sirf fees ka fark. BEHEN ka chai ka cup ruk gaya.

visual.prompt: A small leak in a bucket of water slowly forming a large puddle on the floor over time, SG crouching beside it explaining, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Kyun itna? Kyunki fees har saal poori jama rakam par katti hai, sirf naye paise par nahi. Aur jo paisa fees mein gaya, woh aage compounding bhi nahi kamata. Matlab compounding ulta chalti hai. Chhota sa chhed, lambe samay mein bada gaddha ban jaata hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI at a desk carefully reading on a laptop with a magnifying glass in hand, focused and curious, a cup of chai beside him, evening

scenes.vo: 500 ki SIP par yeh rakam chhoti hogi, par asool wahi hai. Fund chunte waqt sirf pichhla return mat dekho. Expense ratio bhi dekho, aur yeh bhi ki plan regular hai ya direct. Fund ki website aur factsheet pe yeh likha hota hai.

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE and BHAI sitting together across a desk, BANK UNCLE explaining patiently with open hands, BHAI nodding, calm office afternoon

scenes.vo: Agent ki bhi apni jagah hai. Agar koi aapko sahi salah deta hai aur haath pakadkar chalata hai, toh uski fees ka matlab ban sakta hai. Bas jaan bujhkar chuno. Bina jaane fees dete rehna, asli problem yahi hai.

scenes.label: Galti, tax aur kya karein

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt standing at a crossroads with several tempting shop signs as shapes without text, looking back at the viewer with a gentle warning expression, dusk

scenes.vo: Ab woh galti jo sabse zyada log karte hain. SIP shuru karna aasaan hai, chalaate rehna mushkil. Koi crash mein band kar deta hai. Koi naya phone lene ke liye beech mein nikaal leta hai. Aur koi bhool jaata hai ki SIP badhani bhi thi.

visual.prompt: WIFE at the dining table with a notebook and pen, calmly working through household papers, BHAI sitting beside her listening, morning light

scenes.vo: Aur nikaalte waqt tax bhi samjho. Equity fund ke units saal bhar se zyada rakhe, toh munafe par long term capital gains tax lagta hai, yaani lambe samay ke munafe ka tax. Aaj yeh rate 12.5 percent hai.

visual.prompt: WIFE smiling and pointing at her notebook while BHAI looks impressed, a small pile of coins neatly split on the table, warm daylight

scenes.vo: Par har saal 1.25 lakh tak ka aisa munafa tax free hai. Uske upar ke munafe par hi 12.5 percent lagta hai. Toh plan karke, thoda thoda nikaalna, tax ka bojh kam kar sakta hai. Yeh baat zyada log jaante hi nahi.

visual.prompt: BHAI confidently walking out of his office building in the evening with a calm smile, phone in pocket, city lights coming on

scenes.vo: Toh BHAI ne kya seekha? SIP ka auto debit salary ke agle din rakho. Crash aaye toh app kam kholo, SIP chalne do. Plan direct hai ya regular, check karo. Aur jab salary badhe, SIP bhi thodi badhao.

visual.prompt: SG sitting on a sofa in a cosy room, leaning forward with an honest open-handed gesture toward the viewer, soft evening lamp light

scenes.vo: Aur sabse zaroori, return ka koi vaada mat suno. Achha daur bhi aata hai, sust daur bhi. Aapke haath mein bas yeh hai, kitna daalte ho, kitne lambe samay tak, aur kitni fees dete ho. Yeh investment advice nahi hai, apni zaroorat dekhkar faisla kijiye.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta and BHAI in a hoodie sitting side by side on a sofa, PAPA holding a file of papers and smiling at BHAI's phone, MUMMY bringing chai in the background, warm evening

scenes.vo: Aaj BHAI ki SIP ki statement PAPA ki FD ki rasid ke saath file mein rakhi hai. PAPA ab bhi kehte hain FD safe hai. Par ab woh BHAI se poochte hain, beta, tera fund kaisa chal raha hai? Ghar mein FD aur SIP, sab ki jagah hai.

visual.prompt: BETA, a 10-year-old boy, holding up his father's phone toward the viewer with a curious questioning look, living room, afternoon

scenes.vo: Ab aapse sawaal. Aapki SIP regular plan mein hai ya direct mein? Comment mein bas likhiye, regular ya direct. Aur agar pata nahi, toh aaj hi app kholkar check kijiye. Yeh chhota sa kaam, lambe samay mein bada fark la sakta hai.

visual.prompt: SG standing at a doorway waving goodbye with a friendly smile, a hint of a house key and a piggy bank on a side table, golden sunset light

scenes.vo: Agle video mein baat karenge EMI aur SIP ki ladaai ki. Home loan jaldi chukaayein, ya SIP chalaate rahein? Ghar ghar ka sawaal hai, aur jawaab utna seedha nahi jitna lagta hai. Tab tak, seedhi baat, paisa samajh kar lagaiye.
